mechanic.summary: Each Ethereal Shade targets a player and later dashes in a line, damaging every player crossed and applying a long damage-over-time effect.
mechanic.response: Spread the targeted lines so they do not overlap and step out of every other shade's path before the dashes resolve.

provenance.description: Compact tactical classification from Wowhead's Patch 12.1 Voidscar Arena guide and linked spell record.
